Why did we design this knife?
We designed this knife to make commuting, outdoor activities or home use more enjoyable!

This knife has been carefully thought out in terms of shape and size!  It has the characteristics of , lightweight, compact, easy to carry and comfortable to use. And it comes with a titanium tool that can be used to fork fruit/food and toothpick.

Don’t we often encounter situations where we need to cut, fork food, or pick teeth while going out? This knife will solve these troublesome things for you and make you more relaxed and happy!

What scenarios is it suitable for use in?
When staying at home, commuting, or engaging in outdoor activities.
When do you need it?
Need to cut something , fork fruits/food, and pick your teeth.
